162 M. L. DEFOND, R. N. HANN, AND X. HU
 a final primary sample of 813 outside director appointments for 594 firms.
 After deleting 111 observations with missing data for our cross-sectional analysis (primarily data on our governance variables), our final secondary sample includes 702 outside director appointments for 509 firms. We perform
 a univariate event-study analysis using our primary sample, and multivariate
 tests using our secondary sample.
